author: Regimes
description:
AndroidControl-CL
	

This repository contains the AndroidControl-CL dataset for Android GUI control and continual learning.
This dataset is released with the paper:
CGL: Advancing Continual GUI Learning via Reinforcement Fine-Tuning

	
		
		Contents
	


images_360/: screenshot trajectories
json_type_split/: JSONL data files
parquet_convert/: Parquet files for training and evaluation


	
		
		Notes
	


The dataset includes train/test splits by task category.
Please follow the dataset… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Regimes/androidcontrol-cl.
